name: super-review
description: Independent readability and maintainability review for Go, TypeScript, Rust, or Java PRs and local source.

interface.shortDescription: Readability and maintainability review of PRs or local source.
interface.longDescription: Review Go, TypeScript, Rust, or Java PRs, local changes, or an explicitly requested whole project through independent specialist passes. Apply team conventions, verify recommendations, and report coverage without editing or executing the reviewed source.
defaultPrompt: Use Super Review on this PR for readability and maintainability; keep every supported recommendation and report coverage.
Use Super Review on my staged and unstaged changes, focusing on naming and API clarity.
